## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b37e3124468c2ed573458c468586502b753173e3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: every diff path — `.changeset/29735-mobile-shell-files.md`; `ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts`, `mobile/src/index.ts`, `mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx`, `mobile/README.md`; `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx`, `widgets/ImageField.tsx`, new `widgets/nativeImagePick.ts`, new `widgets/nativeImagePick.shellPhoto.test.tsx`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, `views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`, `views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `views/RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts` — read against `main`: `mobile/src/nativeHost.ts` L83–136 (`NativeScanOptions`, the method union, the optional `scan?` precedent), L186–216 (`nativeHostCan`, `callNative`), L244–256 (`nativeScan` / `nativeShowConnectionSwitcher`), `mobile/src/index.ts` L66–100, `fields/package.json` L36 and `app-shell/package.json` L86 (both already depend on `@object-ui/mobile`; `ScanFieldButton.tsx` already imports it), `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` L47–55 (`AttachmentRow`), every `NativeHostMethod` consumer outside the mobile package (none), card #29735, claim 6595193307, amendment 6595245493, and os-dev report 6596330475. The shell contract (`objectstack-ai/mobile` `docs/HYBRID-SHELL.md` "Files", mobile#180) was read as the card quotes it; that repository is outside this session's scope.

Read-only; nothing built or run. Card #29735 (mobile#147 ruling letter A: the Console fetches files with its own session; the shell never touches the session).

### ① Derived judgments

- **The widening is exactly what the claim, the changeset and the report name, and only on `@object-ui/mobile` and `@object-ui/i18n`.** The mobile barrel adds six values (`nativePickImage`, `nativeOpenFile`, `nativeShare`, `fileFromNativeFile`, `nativeFileFromBlob`, `NATIVE_FILE_MAX_BYTES`) and three types (`NativePickImageOptions`, `NativeFile`, `NativeShareContent`); `ObjectStackNative` gains three optional members and `NativeHostMethod` three names. Nothing leaves. Optional members and a union that only grows are additive for every existing implementer and caller: no code outside the mobile package switches on `NativeHostMethod`, and the test fake is the one implementer in the tree. `fields` and `app-shell` already depend on `@object-ui/mobile`, so no dependency edge is added. `nativeImagePick.ts` is not exported from the fields entry. The ten packs gain `fields.file.choosePhoto` and `fields.file.photoFailed`; `ImageField`'s "Take photo" reuses the existing `fields.file.takePhoto`.
- **The wrappers follow the `scan` precedent exactly:** `callNative` feature-detects through `nativeHostCan` (`has(method) === true` and the member is a function) and resolves `unavailable | ok | failed`; the bridge types match the card's contract (`pickImage(opts?)` → `NativeFile | null`, `openFile(NativeFile)` → `null`, `share({ url?, text? })` → `null`, `bad_args` on an oversized file, 8 MiB).
- **Letter A holds at every call site.** `openInNativeShell` runs after the panel has fetched the signed URL with the Console's session as before; it fetches the bytes from that URL and hands the shell `{ base64, name, mime }` only. The size is judged on `row.size` before any byte moves and on `blob.size` after; a non-ok response, a thrown fetch (cross-origin storage without CORS), or any non-`ok` wrapper answer returns `false` and the existing `window.open` runs. `sys_share` hands the shell `location.href` and `document.title`; the Bearer session and the signed URL never cross the bridge, and the new panel tests assert the signed token appears in no shell call.
- **One upload pipeline.** `FileField` routes the picked `File` into its existing `processFiles` (same `maxSize`, same `sys_file` write); `ImageField` lifts its input handler body into `uploadPicked`, which both the input and the shell picker call. The hooks (`useNativeImagePickOffered`) sit before `ImageField`'s readonly early return, so hook order is stable.

### ② Semver level

- Four packages patch, `Clause-②: yes` (bare = widening), `Metadata-protocol: none` → patch is the level the protocol axis gives. No ADR-0087 marker is needed: nothing retires.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not Tier H. CI on `b37e3124` was in progress when this was written (11 success, 11 skipped, 30 in progress, 0 failure). The seat's ACCEPT waits on green.
- `Fixes #29735` closes the card; attachment share is out by the seat's ruling in the amendment, and the card's own list names only a record link for `share`.
- **Overlap to merge, not a conflict of behaviour:** PR #29798 (#29748, app lock row) is open against the same three mobile files (`nativeHost.ts` +37/−1, `index.ts` +3, the test fake) and `locales/en.ts`. Whichever lands second re-merges main for union-line conflicts in the method union, the barrel and the fake's `ALL_METHODS`; the claim already anticipated this with #29750.
- The shell contract was not read from the mobile repository here (outside scope); this record relies on the card's quotation of it, which the seat and the dev both read. If `HYBRID-SHELL.md` "Files" differs from the card on a shape (`maxWidth` range, `text` cap, `bad_args` on a bad name), the bridge types' doc comments are where it would show.

### ④ Design judgment

- Feature-detect, then fall back to exactly today's path, is the right shape for an optional shell capability, and `callNative` resolving `unavailable` within the same task keeps the `navigator.share` fallback's user activation in a plain browser.
- Judging the 8 MiB cap on the row before fetching, and never encoding a file the shell would refuse, is the right reading of the limit; falling back on `bad_args` rather than surfacing it means a tap is never answered worse than before.
- Keeping the signed URL out of the share sheet (option A) is correct: it is a bearer-free credential, and the stable link is dead for a recipient without the session.
- Narrowing face: nothing is taken away; the `<input type=file>` camera path stays for `capture: false` and for every host without `pickImage`.

No must-fix. No should-fix.
